typography.guidelines: Manrope for headings, IBM Plex Sans for body copy. IBM Plex Mono is the signature accent face for metadata: counts, dates, priority/status pills, stat numbers, kbd hints, breadcrumbs — it is what separates this from a generic dashboard.

colors.archetype: Cool professional workspace — paper gray, blue accent
colors.guidelines: Cool paper gray (#F4F6F8) with white surfaces and a single blue accent (#3368A0). Sidebar is white with a tinted active row. Semantic colors (success/danger/warning) stay independent of brand color.

spacing_and_layout.strategy: High Density Grid — Compact and Scannable
spacing_and_layout.guidelines: Cards are flat (1px border, no ambient shadow) at rest; elevation (lift + shadow) appears only on hover/focus. Keep padding compact and consistent with the existing density (task cards ~11px, page padding ~28px 4.5%).

motion.guidelines: Every interactive element gets a targeted transition (never `transition: all`): buttons lift on hover and scale down slightly on press; tabs and nav items animate background/color; kanban cards, overview cards, and list rows fade+rise in on mount (`riseIn` keyframe); modals and dropdowns fade+scale in (`modalIn`); the unread notification dot pulses (`pulseDot`). Keyframes live in index.css and are reused across App.css/team.css/extra.css.

kanban_cards.guidelines: Quiet cards: no floating badges. Priority is a 7px color dot. Due date is muted unless overdue. Menu appears on hover inside the card.

sidebar.guidelines: White sidebar, no gradient. Active item uses accent-tint fill, accent-hover text, and a 2px accent inset-left indicator.

topbar.guidelines: 58px first row. Tabs are underline-style, all visible (no overflow menu). Account actions live in the avatar menu — no duplicate logout.

task_detail_modal.guidelines: Compact padding, low-profile inputs (8-10px). Mono font for breadcrumb, labels, and section eyebrows.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Do NOT touch or remove any existing `data-testid` attributes in the JS files.
2. Do NOT change the LABEL_COLORS swatch palette values (CreateTeamModal.jsx / TaskDetailModal.jsx) — they are embedded in generated data-testid strings.
3. All visual styling lives in App.css, extra.css, team.css and the font import in index.css — prefer editing those over adding inline styles or Tailwind classes to JSX.
4. Keep class names stable; only change declarations inside existing rules or add new rules for a genuinely new class.

5. Reuse the CSS custom properties defined in App.css :root (--paper, --surface, --ink, --muted, --line, --accent, --accent-hover, --accent-tint, --success, --danger, --warning, --violet, --teal, --rose, --r-sm, --r-md, --r-lg, --font-heading, --font-body, --font-mono) instead of hardcoding new hex values.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, but keep cards sharp for dense data tools.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern, sharp button styles (e.g., 6px radius) with interaction animations for dashboard context.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions. Static = dead.
